audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page is built around Blinding Dart, and the advice it gives is inert. Blind stops basic attacks. Blooming Blows, Watch Out! Eep! and Swirlseed are abilities, and Dream Dust comes from spells hitting — none of it is affected. The page tells you to 'trade with spells while it is up', 'schedule your pattern around its cooldown' and 'step up only on its downtime', and says his blind makes your Dream Dust procs whiff.
audit.why: A reader waiting out a 7-second dart before every trade concedes the lane for nothing, and 'Nothing here works through Blinding Dart' is the exact opposite of the truth. The mirror (teemo__lillia) reached the same conclusion independently.
audit.corrected: winCon, report[1].t, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[0], whys[2], whys[6], spikes[3], early, mid, late and both wants lines rewritten around what actually beats you: 680 range against your 450 ring, Move Quick spacing, and shroom coverage.

edits.before: Teemo owns Levels 1-3 outright. You only have one Q hop and no kite chain yet, and the second you step into Q range to apply Dream Dust he blinds you and kites back on his passive move speed, so your passive auto-procs and W follow-up whiff. His E poison plus an auto chips more than your single sweetspot, and you have no sustain button to heal it. Last-hit with the very tip of your Q from max range, eat the poke, and do not chase a hop you cannot land.
edits.after: Teemo owns levels 1-3 outright, though not for the reason the page used to give: Blinding Dart blanks basic attacks, and every one of your abilities lands through it. The problem is range — his 680 beats your 450 ring, and Move Quick carries him out the moment you close to apply Dream Dust. Toxic Shot plus an auto chips more than your single sweetspot and you have no sustain button. Last-hit with the very tip of your Q, eat the poke, and never chase a hop you cannot land.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 would be your window into a melee, but Teemo just out-ranges your hops and re-applies poison faster than your DoT compounds, so you stay behind. At 6, Lilting Lullaby is your only genuine threat: land Swirlseed for the slow, layer Dream Dust, and the delayed sleep can catch a Teemo who over-extends — but the delay means it is far more reliable with a jungler collapsing than solo. Never burn your kite chasing him onto a shroom; bait the blind onto a throwaway Q first, then commit E-W only when it is down.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 would be your window in a melee, but Teemo out-ranges your hops and re-applies Toxic Shot faster than the DoT compounds, so you stay behind. At 6 Lilting Lullaby is your only genuine threat, and the order is not optional: Swirlseed for the slow, then Dream Dust, because the sleep only lands on enemies already carrying it. The delay makes it far more reliable with a jungler collapsing. Never chase him onto a shroom — and stop holding abilities for his blind, which cannot touch them.

edits.before: This stays his lane. His shrooms carpet every path you would kite through and his blind negates your passive autos in every skirmish, so a straight 1v1 into him is a losing fight all game. Your job is to stop feeding the lane: rush Liandry's so your W and DoT do real percent-HP work in grouped fights, then roam and use your speed to influence the map instead of dueling him. Win through teamfight burn and pick potential with your ult, not by trying to reclaim a lane his range and mushrooms own.
